outcome: Deliver a deterministic Harness v7.0 successor that governs n8n/code/hybrid execution-plane decisions and safely adopts greenfield, brownfield, and prior-Harness projects without conflating governance installation with application migration.
acceptance_criteria: The immutable v6.0 directory and archive remain unchanged and the source archive SHA-256 is recorded.

A normative policy and machine contract classify automations as code, n8n, or hybrid using explicit eligibility criteria, hard blockers, ownership, reliability, security, cost, and evidence requirements.

Production n8n decisions require versioned sanitized workflows, environment separation, least-privilege credentials, bounded retries, idempotency, failure handling, observability, retention, rollback, and a kill switch.
A normative adoption policy and machine contract independently classify adoption mode, existing Harness posture, application posture, file ownership, conflicts, approvals, and migration requirements.
A bounded adopt_harness.py plan/apply/verify workflow is read-only by default, performs full preflight, never overwrites project-owned or conflicting content, and emits a machine-readable plan.

Greenfield adoption can initialize the default Python/React profile; brownfield adoption preserves the detected stack and never creates application-template directories implicitly; upgrades preserve project memory and use explicit migration steps.
Architecture validation distinguishes absent applications, observed brownfield profiles, target profiles, and migration-required states without treating an unknown topology as not applicable.
Prompts, skills, schemas, scripts, fixtures, documentation, migration guidance, manifests, SBOM, provenance, version metadata, and package inventory agree on v7 behavior.
Positive and negative tests cover adoption modes, ownership conflicts, zero-write failures, unsafe paths, untrusted plans, automation hard blockers, invalid n8n evidence, and v6-to-v7 compatibility.
All applicable gates close without unresolved blockers and a deterministic v7 archive passes manifest, path, resource, and fresh-extraction verification with a recorded SHA-256.

in: Create managed task, architecture, gate, migration, and qualification evidence for v7.
Derive agent-runtime-v7.0 from the verified immutable v6.0 baseline.
Implement automation execution-plane and Harness adoption policies, schemas, scripts, validation, tests, prompts, and documentation.
Run bounded local validation and deterministic packaging with synthetic fixtures.
out: Modify any released v6.0 or earlier directory or archive.
Mutate a real downstream project, n8n instance, database, external service, or production environment.
Install network dependencies, deploy, commit, push, publish, message, rotate credentials, or run external security tests.

Incorrect automation routing could place business authority or sensitive operations in an unsuitable execution plane.
Packaging and migration errors could overwrite project-owned governance or memory.
